nativePatch.purpose: Observability only, not an original-cause fix

conditionalIncremental.buildHost: same Linux cross-build host family as saved objects
conditionalIncremental.runner: standard public ubuntu runner only after actual compatibility/resource checks

resourceConditions.diskBudgetFormula: archive + expanded objdir + checkout + SDK/toolchains + output + link temporaries + existing swap + 8GiB reserve; compare against actual free space

preconditions: Obtain and verify the required payload through an authorized supported route; verify provider digest, ZIP CRC and safe archive layout.

Verify Runtime source and every pre-existing source patch, original generated headers, backend, config.status data, mozinfo, target, deployment target, PGO/Debug/test flags and source/objdir path compatibility.
Read config.status as data; do not execute it during eligibility inspection.
Verify exact compiler, linker, plugin, Rust and SDK identities and full recorded argv; configuration must match the saved variant.
Resolve the one host-object target and every owner archive/response file from the saved backend. The exact target and argv are currently UNRESOLVED.
Verify all xul link input hashes, including Rust archives and profile-runtime dependencies; resource enforcement must be demonstrably effective.
Independently review the final exact commands, flags, inputs, outputs and time/resource limits before any execution.
permittedIfEligible: Compile the complete real MacWebAppService.mm translation unit using the exact saved compiler argv.
Update only declared owner archives or object lists if required by the saved graph.
Link xul outside any app bundle using a verified signature-free linker invocation.
hardStops: Any missing/changed dependency, incompatible header, compiler, SDK, flag or path
Any other TU or Rust compilation
Any dependency installation, global toolchain/settings change or swap reconfiguration
Any timestamp manipulation to suppress rebuilds
Any signing or implicit linker code-signing requirement
Any unexplained process, memory, disk or time-budget excess
prohibitedEntrypoints: Normal common-build/wrapper invocation as an incremental shortcut
Unrestricted mach build, mach build binaries, or fallback full build
make -n as proof that evaluating the build graph is read-only

publicSourceFacts: Runtime verify-runtime-artifact.yml signs the test host copy ad hoc.
Floorp test-context-menu.py calls seal_bundle, whose test-runtime.py implementation signs a newly created Shim.app ad hoc.
Removing only the host signing step does not remove signing from the existing authentication fixture.
requirementsForAnyLaterAuthenticationRun: A new package with the changed xul and verified native/source provenance
A permitted package/fixture signature path; do not reuse stale signature claims
Unchanged code-signature, audit PID/UID, cdHash, designated-requirement, nonce and ownership predicates
Bounded native-run evidence tied to the exact new package and attempt
authenticationGate.linkerCaveat: LLVM19.1.7 Mach-O lld defaults to ad-hoc signing on macOS arm64/arm64e. x64 default is false but actual linker and all argv are unverified, so linking is not presumed signature-free.

minimumFullAlternative.scope: One x86_64 Linux-to-macOS native dependency build: configure/generated headers plus all native and Rust inputs needed for the real host TU and xul. Preserve the normal source fixes and upstream tests for canonical Debug. No ARM/universal merge, package signing, authentication harness, release or publish.
minimumFullAlternative.configuration: Use Runtime7dd plus the reviewed diagnostic patch before configure. The old non-PGO run is intended Debug by workflow inference; verify compiled Debug/test flags independently. Preserve PGO generate/use in regular pipelines; do not convert the saved profgen objdir into a non-PGO objdir.
minimumFullAlternative.signingConstraint: Before running a full compile/link recipe, prove every invoked build rule and linker is within the signature-free scope; stop if signing or an unknown post-link step is required.

cost.artifactStorage: Separate, depends on quota, bytes and retention; no invoice total is claimed.

minimumFullAlternative.capacity: Published standard Ubuntu SSD is 14GB; a full Gecko build needs more space than this published baseline. Require observed free space and validated complete build/link budget before any job. Do not assume a larger disk or silently select a paid runner.
minimumFullAlternative.regularBuildAlternative: A future separately authorized regular native build can apply the patch before compilation and emit compact provenance/configuration/dependency metadata. Preserve PGO profiling/optimization and existing publication gates.
